about: Where every file in brand/ came from, with its SHA-256. build.py refreshes the hashes.

README.md.source: The usage sheet for this brand home.

brand.json.source: Written for this brand home: the repo has no logo mark, so there is no icon block; the one surface file the repository already serves is the docs site social card, docs/public/og.png.

og/firestore_odm-og.png.source: docs/public/og.png, moved here unchanged. Added in 3ec564a, 2026-09-25 ("firestore_odm 5.1.0: the maintained successor to cloud_firestore_odm", PR #61, merged as 21ef368). Neither the commit message nor the pull request records how it was made, and the repository holds no vector source: it is a raster master, a 1280x640 RGB PNG with no metadata. 1280x640 is the GitHub social-preview size and the size of the other Sylphx social previews made the same day; the wave art matches Mark's banner style (mark.sylphx.com), the service the README hero also comes from.

svg/firestore_odm-symbol.svg.source: TODO: say where this master came from

tokens.json.source: Written for this brand home: the colour and type roles the README hero uses, read from the hero SVG served by mark.sylphx.com (type=aurora, theme=grape). The docs site defines no brand colours of its own (stock VitePress theme), so none are recorded from it. Docs-theme roles (ground-alt/elv/soft, link, button) added 2026-10 for the docs site; contrast checked against WCAG AA.
